caption: The drawing features two renderings of a single object, which appears to be a decorative stand or andiron. On the right, the object is depicted in a three-dimensional, shaded view, rendered primarily in tones of gold and brown, suggesting a metallic material. The object has a bulbous, rounded top with a finial, a narrowed section beneath it, and a wider central column that tapers down to a rounded base. From the base, three curved legs extend outward and downward, each ending in a rounded ball foot. The left side of the image contains a simplified line drawing of the same object, showing its contours and dimensions without shading, along with a horizontal ruler marked in inches underneath it. The entire composition is framed with a thin black line, and the signature "Hans Korsch" is visible in the lower right corner. The background is a light cream or beige color.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
